claims: n-172-candidate.yaml is a packing.squares:Witness/v2 file (corners, rational scalars, 172 squares) whose exact rational side, rounded up at 12 places, #935 prints as the bound. Its exact coordinates were produced by this repository's packing-witness promote --strategy robust-rational at ef1af493 from the lab's decimal pose, n-172-decimal-pose.yaml, with center_dilation '1' and no dilation: pairs separated by at least about 2e-13, the squares that set the left wall, the bottom wall and the side touching them exactly, and other squares near a wall clearing it by up to about 1e-12. An upper bound only: no KKT, local-optimality, rigidity or global-optimality claim.

n172-witness.json is the same file as JSON. packing-witness-verify.txt is the author's run of this repository's packing-witness verify at ef1af493 on the witness placed under packing/witnesses/known-best/ (VERIFIED, exact-algebraic, 14706 pairs); sqcheck-output.txt is the author's run of verifier/sqcheck.py, an exact checker the source says was written separately from this repository's code (VALID, exact rational, the exact side rounded up at 15 places). The issue says sqcheck.py also certified the decimal pose in interval arithmetic at its own side before promotion. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.

The issue and README say the packing starts from the registry's current 172 packing, taken from this repository's regularized known-best atlas, and was found by basin hopping (kick, rotate, swap and reinsert moves) over local minima computed by Evan Daniel's ALM+SLP quench (evand/square-packing search/packer at bb4cc78e, MIT), built unmodified into the lab's search; they ask that the improvement be credited to Doğa Özden, the base packing to its holders as the record lists them, and the local optimizer to Evan Daniel. The issue says the search and its code were written and run by AI agents and that the checks were run by code that did not produce the packing; the issue and repository were prepared and posted by Özden's AI agent, which uses the account kenaznia-doga; Özden directed the work.
